requests.title: Contact, demo and support requests
requests.intro: Everything the public forms deliver, with status, assignee and forwarding state. Replies go out by e-mail in the requester's language; every status change, assignment and reply is audited.
requests.caption: Contact requests, newest first
requests.emptyText: Requests from the public contact, demo and support forms appear here as soon as someone sends one.
requests.emptyFilteredText: Widen the filters or reset them.
requests.legacyNotice: Every request from the public forms is now a support ticket (channel “contact form”) and is worked on in Support. This list is kept for requests submitted before the desk existed and links each newer request to its ticket.

detail.userLinkedYes: Yes, the requester was signed in

spamDialog.title: Mark as spam?
spamDialog.description: The request disappears from the open view and no reply can be sent until it is reopened. This is recorded in the audit log.

reply.title: Reply by e-mail
reply.intro: Your text is wrapped in the reply template of the requester's language: greeting, your name as signature and the reference {reference}. The audit log records that a reply was sent, not its text.
reply.bodyHint: 10 to 4,000 characters. Plain text; the greeting and signature are added automatically.
reply.spamBlocked: Requests marked as spam cannot be answered. Reopen the request first.

dialog.title: Send this reply?
dialog.description: The e-mail goes to {email} with the subject “{subject}”. Sending is recorded in the audit log.

reply.sentFile: Reply written to the local outbox (no mail transport configured in this environment).

trail.caption: Audited actions on this request, newest first

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.intro: Data subject requests of every organisation: how many are open, which are overdue and when the next one is due. Subjects, reports and notes stay in the tenant's privacy centre — operators see counts and dates only.
privacy.unavailableText: The data subject request tables are not applied to this database, so nothing can be counted.
privacy.tenantPath: Customers handle their requests in Consent & Privacy (/app/consent) of their own dashboard.
privacy.caption: Data subject requests per organisation, most urgent first
privacy.emptyText: No organisation has created a data subject request yet.

alerts.title: Alert digest
alerts.intro: Alert events of the last {days} days across all organisations, grouped by kind and organisation: how many fired, how many are still open, how many were critical. Facts of single events stay in the customer's alert history.
alerts.unavailableText: The alert tables (migration 0013) are not applied to this database, so nothing can be counted.
alerts.caption: Alert events per organisation and kind, most open first
alerts.empty: No alerts in the last {days} days
alerts.emptyText: No organisation's alert rules fired in this window.

knowledge.title: Knowledge feedback
knowledge.intro: “Was this article helpful?” votes from Tracking Knowledge of the last {days} days per article, lowest helpful share first. Votes are anonymous by design: no address, no session, no tenant — so the digest tells the editorial team which articles need work and nothing else.
knowledge.unavailableText: The knowledge feedback table (migration 0005) is not applied to this database, so nothing can be counted.
knowledge.caption: Feedback per article, lowest helpful share first
knowledge.empty: No votes in the last {days} days
